description: This file defines the IMediaKeysClient interface, which is an abstract base class for handling media key events such as license requests, license renewals, and key status changes within the Rialto media framework. It is part of the Rialto media decryption API, intended to be implemented by clients and servers to receive notifications related to media key sessions.

classes.name: IMediaKeysClient
classes.description: An interface for receiving notifications about media key events such as license requests, renewals, and key status changes in the Rialto media framework.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Callback invoked when a license request is needed, providing the session ID, license request message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Callback invoked when a license renewal is required, providing the session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the status of keys in a session has changed, providing the session ID and key status vector.
